job_title: Group Head of IT Resilience & Site Reliability Engineering (SRE)
role_summary: Group-level executive owning enterprise IT resilience, service reliability, and platform modernization across infrastructure, multi-cloud, and core system applications for a pan-Asian insurer. Sets reliability objectives, governs error-budget policy and production change risk for new business and customer-facing services, chairs the Group Resilience Council, and drives a federated SRE operating model across Group Office and Business Units. Leads legacy modernization, DR/HA strategy, observability/AIOps platform ownership, executive reporting to GMT, and SRE capability building.
must_have_requirements: Bachelor's or Master's in Computer Science, IT, Engineering, or related field
8-10+ years leading managers across multi-region operations
Proven track record leading enterprise resilience and modernization transformations (legacy remediation, cloud adoption, platform standardization, operating model change)
SRE practices at scale: SLO/SLI design, error budgets, chaos engineering, capacity management
Deep expertise with multi-cloud (AWS/Azure/GCP), Kubernetes, CI/CD, OpenTelemetry, enterprise observability
Experience with HA architecture, DR planning (RTO/RPO tiers), and failover strategy
Budget ownership, vendor/commercial leadership, and FinOps targets
Executive-level reporting to senior management (GMT/Exco) on production risk and major incidents
P1/P2 incident command, escalation protocol design, RCA leadership, and MTTR reduction
Observability & AIOps platforms (Elastic, Datadog, Dynatrace; anomaly detection/correlation)
Excellent communication and stakeholder management fluent in English
nice_to_have_requirements: Familiarity with ITIL 4, ISO 22301/27001, NIST 800-61 incident response
Understanding of IT operations, BCP/DR, and regulatory expectations in insurance
Experience building embedded/federated SRE chapters across business units
Experience running an internal SRE Academy / capability program
Infrastructure-as-code and modernization patterns (refactoring, replatforming, legacy decomposition)
soft_skills_priority: Cross-functional leadership across Group and BUs

scoring_criteria.name: SRE at Scale & Reliability Engineering
scoring_criteria.why_it_matters: Core of the role is owning Group-wide reliability objectives, SLO/SLI design, and error-budget governance.

scoring_criteria.name: Enterprise Resilience & DR/HA Transformation
scoring_criteria.why_it_matters: Must strategize, enforce, and govern HA/DR/failover standards across all systems.

scoring_criteria.name: Platform Modernization & Legacy Remediation
scoring_criteria.why_it_matters: Leads modernization roadmaps, target-state architecture, and technical debt reduction for core systems.

scoring_criteria.name: Multi-Cloud, Kubernetes & Observability Depth
scoring_criteria.why_it_matters: Deep hands-on/architectural expertise across AWS/Azure/GCP, K8s, CI/CD, and observability/AIOps stacks is required.

scoring_criteria.name: Senior Leadership & Multi-Region Org Building
scoring_criteria.why_it_matters: Requires 8-10+ years leading managers across regions and building a global SRE bench in a federated model.
scoring_criteria.gap_expected: Candidates may lack the specific federated 'embedded chapters' model but have equivalent matrixed leadership.

scoring_criteria.name: Incident Command, RCA & Escalation Governance
scoring_criteria.why_it_matters: Owns P1/P2 escalation protocol, drives RCA/troubleshooting, and reduces incident recurrence.

scoring_criteria.name: Executive Reporting & Stakeholder Engagement
scoring_criteria.why_it_matters: Reports production risk and major incidents to GMT/Exco and drives cross-Group stakeholder alignment.

scoring_criteria.name: Budget, FinOps & Vendor/SLA Ownership
scoring_criteria.why_it_matters: Owns SRE platform budget, FinOps targets, and vendor SLA outcomes.

scoring_criteria.name: Insurance/Regulated Domain & Compliance Frameworks
scoring_criteria.why_it_matters: Familiarity with insurance IT operations, BCP/DR regulation, ITIL 4, ISO 22301/27001, and NIST 800-61.
scoring_criteria.gap_expected: Adjacent regulated industries (banking, fintech, healthcare) can substitute for insurance-specific experience.

summary_focus: Group/enterprise-scale SRE and IT resilience leadership across multi-region operations
Quantified reliability outcomes (SLO coverage, MTTR reduction, availability improvements)
Modernization transformations: legacy remediation, cloud adoption, platform standardization
Multi-cloud, Kubernetes, observability/AIOps, and CI/CD depth
Executive-level reporting and federated operating model leadership
do_not_overclaim: Do not claim insurance-specific experience if from an adjacent industry; state the transferable domain
Do not fabricate GMT/Exco/board reporting if experience is at a lower tier; specify actual audience
Do not claim Chinese written proficiency unless genuinely held
Do not overstate scale (customer/market counts) beyond verifiable roles
Do not claim ownership of specific tools (Dynatrace/Datadog/Elastic) unless actually used

cover_letter_guidance.tone: Executive, confident, and outcome-driven with measured humility
cover_letter_guidance.positioning: Position as a senior technology leader who translates reliability and modernization strategy into governed, measurable outcomes across a federated multi-region enterprise, balancing engineering rigor with executive stakeholder influence.
bridge_gaps_honestly: If not from insurance, cite comparable regulated/high-availability industries and readiness to learn insurance-specific compliance
If Chinese proficiency is absent, emphasize strong English communication and prior cross-cultural APAC experience
If federated 'embedded chapters' model is new, map to equivalent matrixed/CoE leadership experience
If specific certs (ITIL 4, ISO, NIST) are informal, note applied working knowledge rather than formal certification
